description: This file defines a PHP class 'MyInfoAPI' which provides an API endpoint for retrieving employee details of the currently logged-in user in the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It utilizes OpenAPI annotations for API documentation, extends a base Endpoint class, and implements methods to handle GET requests for employee information with selectable detail models.

classes.name: MyInfoAPI
classes.description: A class that provides a REST API endpoint for fetching current employee's information with different detail models in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve the current employee's information, returning a model object based on the requested detail level.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the GET request, including optional 'model' query parameter.

methods.name: getModelClass
methods.description: Determines the model class to use based on the 'model' query parameter, defaulting to 'default'.
